short_description:
GTA 6's easiest early money is underwater. After the Island Dreams mission you can get scuba gear and a metal detector, and shipwreck dive sites open up; guides count six wrecks around Key Lento. The treasure sells for a lot early on. Light on spoilers: only where it unlocks. Every spot: vicereplay.com (Guides → GTA 6 Map).

Map: Rockstar Games' official Leonida map. Sources: Slashgear, VGC, games.gg, GTABoom.
